Average block-level estimates to get overall ATE

Source: R/helper_interacted_estimators.R
generate_all_interacted_estimates.Rd

Also calculate associated standard error.

Usage

generate_all_interacted_estimates(
  fitModel,
  data,
  use_full_vcov = FALSE,
  SE_table = NULL,
  method = "LR",
  weight = NULL,
  se_method = "crve",
  aggregated = FALSE,
  include_block_estimates = FALSE
)

Arguments

fitModel

The model that has the interacted estimates in it.

data

Data frame the model was fit on (in canonical form).

use_full_vcov

TRUE/FALSE. When calculating standard errors, should the full variance-covariance matrix of the block-level estimates be used, or just the diagonal of standard errors?

SE_table

Optional precomputed table of block-level standard errors to use instead of extracting them from `fitModel`.

method

Prefix of the method. Will add the weighting to stem.

weight

"Person" or "Cluster" weighting used when averaging block-level estimates to an overall ATE.

se_method

Which standard error method the block-level estimates in `fitModel`/`SE_table` were computed with (e.g. "crve", "het", "db"). Used only for labeling.

aggregated

TRUE means data is summarized at the Block level. False means it is not, and needs to be aggregated.

include_block_estimates

If TRUE, also return the block-by-block estimates used to build the overall estimate, in addition to the aggregate estimate.
